findings.description: First-hit qualification and direct index dependency.
findings.resolution: Skip absent or S19 false for the first hit; no search for a later qualified recross in the same Reset interval. Direct lower_index call has no local null-index or empty-window guard; no coarse fallback.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: Filtered successor and equal-time window behavior.
findings.resolution: Search start=max(confirmation,candidate event,A stop), end=min(deadline,next filtered aligned confirmation or deadline); skip start>=end, including equal-confirmation windows. Do not merge equal-time aligned rows or use the next unfiltered trend row.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: First-hit Blue qualification and direct index dependency.
findings.resolution: skip absent or no S21 Blue from candidate source main time through the first crossing. No rescan for a later crossing within the same window; direct lower_index call has no local null-index guard.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.
